messages.text: 'use proactively' marking found — encourages autonomous delegation

writing.overall_comment: A well-scoped and explicit Python test subagent with strong boundaries and output contract, marred only by redundant expertise sections that could be tightened.

dimensions.name: Delegation fit
dimensions.comment: The description clearly scopes routing to Python test generation with named frameworks, making it easy for a main agent to decide when to invoke it.

dimensions.name: Prompt quality
dimensions.comment: Role, mandatory naming/AAA conventions, and an explicit output contract (files, test count, run result, uncovered APIs) are all spelled out.

dimensions.name: Boundaries
dimensions.comment: It explicitly forbids modifying production code, over-mocking, and non-Python work, and lists concrete hand-back triggers.

dimensions.name: Conciseness
dimensions.comment: The prompt is long and repetitive—expertise lists, integrated skills, and DO/DON'T sections restate the same naming and structure rules, inflating the token cost.

suggestions: Deduplicate the naming and structure rules that currently appear in the expertise lists, integrated skills, and DO/DON'T sections, keeping a single canonical statement near the top of the prompt.
Rewrite the DO/DON'T section as a short checklist containing only constraints not already covered by the consolidated naming and structure rules.
Trim the expertise lists and integrated skills by removing repeated naming/structure guidance and retaining only role-specific capabilities.
